Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
No extra tools or special equipment are needed! Here is what makes getting started simple:
Tool-free assembly: All Cozey modular sofas connect using integrated clips or leg connectors, so you won't need power tools or specialized equipment.
Modular delivery: Your furniture arrives in manageable, compact boxes that fit easily through standard doorways and hallways. You can bring the boxes into your room one by one and assemble close to where you want the sofa.
Included hardware: All necessary components and hardware are included (often packed inside zippered compartments under the seat bases).
Assembly guides: Step-by-step instructions are available on our Assembly Guides page.
If you would like personalized guidance on layouts, fabrics, or choosing the right setup, you can also schedule a free Design Consultation.

What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?
All Cozey items come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them.
Here are the key details:
Free returns: Returns are completely free during your 30-day trial as long as the items are returned in their original packaging.
Original packaging: Please keep your original boxes. If any original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) will be deducted from your refund.
How to return: You can initiate a return through our Self-Service Portal by logging into your account.
Refunds: Once our Quality Assurance Team receives and inspects the item to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications, your refund will be processed within 3–7 business days.
